SELECT a.id, a.s_mail, a.title, a.email_body, a.link, b.ten_mail as ten_s_mail, b.username_smail, '' as ten_r_mail, b.mk_mail, b.smtp_server, b.smtp_port, b.type_smail, s.data as r_mail
FROM allsmail a
LEFT JOIN dmsmail b on a.s_mail = b.s_mail
CROSS APPLY ISWIFTFunction$Split(a.ds_mail, ',') s
WHERE a.id = @id;
